messages:
Alex: heads up — customer acme-corp reporting mass Decrypt 403s after nightly key rotation, started ~03:12 UTC. Billing alert triggered due to retries. stack traces show KMS returns AccessDenied and logs show encryption-context mismatch in proxy logs.

Maria: yikes. which key/alias did they rotate? any CloudTrail evidence of rotation/replicate events?

Alex: alias: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/acme-prod-primary. rotation-runner reported success at 03:07. deploy-bot says rotation job finished: ✅

deploy-bot: rotation job completed for alias/acme-prod-primary at 2026-03-15T03:07:12Z

Sam-ops: @Maria @Alex can you paste the failing API request (sanitized) and the KMS decrypt call from the proxy logs? want to check EncryptionContext keys.

Alex: here's a clipped proxy log (sanitized):

```
2026-03-15T03:12:45Z proxy[kms-proxy]: DECRYPT failed tenant=acme-corp key=arn:...:alias/acme-prod-primary error=AccessDenied context="{\"tenant_id\":\"acme-corp\",\"request_id\":\"rq-9ab3\"}"
2026-03-15T03:12:45Z aws.kms: DecryptCalled KeyId=alias/acme-prod-primary EncryptionContext={tenant_id=acme-corp,request_id=rq-9ab3}
2026-03-15T03:12:45Z aws.kms: DecryptResponse Error=AccessDenied Message="EncryptionContext mismatch"
```

Maria: that looks like the proxy sent EncryptionContext but KMS evaluated policy and denied. Two common causes: (1) key policy/GRANT changed during rotation, (2) the context key/format changed (e.g., base64 vs utf8 or truncated field).

Jess: customer reports their side also saw an increase in request latency and then retries — could be client SDK auto-retry causing billing spike. they rotated key from CMK to external HSM-backed key during maintenance window.

Security-oncall: tagging for priority. @sam-ops can you confirm whether grant tokens were issued to the proxy after the alias swap? if proxy was still using stale grant token, KMS could deny.

Sam-ops: checking — proxy instance logs show grant-token stale warning around 03:08. I see our grant service attempted to re-grant but hit IAM condition error.

Alex: relevant IAM condition from CloudTrail event: "Condition Missing: kms:EncryptionContext:tenant_id" on PutGrant call. it looks like the PutGrant request omitted the tenant_id context when creating the grant against the new key.

Maria: aha — that matches. our PutGrant enforcement requires tenant_id in EncryptionContext for multi-tenant keys. if the grant was created without that context the subsequent Decrypt expecting that context will fail.

Alex: reproduction steps I used in staging:
1) rotate alias to new CMK
2) run proxy without updating grant call to include EncryptionContext
3) call Decrypt with EncryptionContext {tenant_id=acme-corp}

Command used (staged):
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd --encryption-context file://ctx.json
```
ctx.json: {"tenant_id":"acme-corp","request_id":"test-rq"}

Result: AccessDenied EncryptionContext mismatch unless PutGrant was created using same context.

Jess: good reproduce. what's the mitigation for production? rollback alias? update grant flow?

Maria: short term: re-run grant creation with correct EncryptionContext for the new key and rotate grant tokens so proxy refreshes. Longer term: add validation in rotation job to ensure PutGrant includes required context keys and fail the rotation if missing.

Sam-ops: I'm pushing a one-off grant re-create now and forcing proxy to refresh grants. will post steps.

Sam-ops: ACTIONS I'm running:
- create PutGrant with EncryptionContext {tenant_id=acme-corp}
- invalidate grant cache on proxy instances (POST /internal/grants/refresh)
- monitor Decrypt 403s and billing alert

Alex: sending customer a short note: "we're applying a fix to grant creation and forcing the proxy to refresh grants; expect reduced errors within ~5 minutes. will update." ☎️

support-bot: sent customer message to acme-corp (ticket #7890), updated with ETA

Sam-ops: done. PutGrant succeeded. proxies reported grant cache refresh at 03:19.

proxy-bot: grant-cache-refresh triggered on 4 instances at 2026-03-15T03:19:10Z

Alex: monitoring — error rate dropped to baseline, billing retries subsiding. CloudTrail now shows Decrypt success events for tenant_id context.

Maria: follow-ups: (1) add pre-check to rotation job to validate PutGrant request content, (2) add alert if grant-token-stale warnings appear during rotation, (3) update runbook with step to re-run PutGrant and force proxy refresh.

Security-oncall: agree. assign to eng-security backlog and sam-ops to own the immediate postmortem notes. tagging for compliance audit: we need to record the time window where decrypts failed and whether any data access was attempted without tenant context.

Jess: confirmed, filing compliance artifact. wrapping up ticket after PM approval.

Alex: closing thread — incident mitigated at 03:22 UTC. will follow up with a short postmortem doc.
